title: Polystyrene microplastics drive chondrotoxicity in osteoarthritis through inducing ER stress and apoptosis via NFKB1 activation.
authors: Pan, Jingxin; Wang, Xi; Gao, Ying; Cheng, Debin; Ma, Jianbing; Zhang, Zhao; Wang, Zhiyuan
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究聚苯乙烯微塑料通过NFKB1激活诱导软骨细胞ER应激和凋亡促进骨关节炎，虽涉及分子对接与动态模拟，但核心是环境毒理学与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Polystyrene microplastics (PS-MPs), recognized as widespread environmental contaminants, have been identified within human articular tissues. However, their contribution to the pathogenesis of osteoarthritis (OA) remains incompletely understood. In this study, a combination of network toxicology and transcriptomic profiling was employed to pinpoint 30 core targets implicated in PS-MP-induced OA. Functional enrichment analyses indicated significant associations with inflammatory processes, endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, and apoptotic pathways. Through machine learning algorithms, six potential diagnostic biomarkers for early-stage OA were identified. Among these, NFKB1 emerged as a core target, with both molecular docking and dynamic simulations confirming its stable interaction with PS-MPs. Subsequent in vitro assays and single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that PS-MPs upregulate NFKB1 expression, thereby intensifying inflammation, ER stress, and chondrocyte apoptosis. Notably, pharmacological inhibition of NFKB1 using MD-1 mitigated these deleterious effects and preserved extracellular matrix integrity. These findings elucidate a mechanistic pathway by which PS-MPs contribute to OA progression through NFKB1-driven ER stress and apoptosis, providing novel perspectives on environmentally induced OA pathology and identifying a potential therapeutic target for countering PS-MP-related chondrotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 聚苯乙烯微塑料（PS-MPs）作为广泛存在的环境污染物，已被发现存在于人类关节组织中。然而，它们对骨关节炎（OA）发病机制的贡献尚未完全阐明。本研究结合网络毒理学和转录组学分析，确定了30个与PS-MP诱导的OA相关的核心靶点。功能富集分析表明，这些靶点与炎症过程、内质网（ER）应激和凋亡通路显著相关。通过机器学习算法，识别出六个早期OA的潜在诊断生物标志物。其中，NFKB1被确定为核心靶点，分子对接和动态模拟均证实其与PS-MPs的稳定相互作用。随后的体外实验和单细胞RNA测序显示，PS-MPs上调NFKB1表达，从而加剧炎症、ER应激和软骨细胞凋亡。值得注意的是，使用MD-1对NFKB1进行药理学抑制可减轻这些有害效应，并保持细胞外基质完整性。这些发现阐明了PS-MPs通过NFKB1驱动的ER应激和凋亡促进OA进展的机制通路，为环境诱导的OA病理提供了新视角，并确定了对抗PS-MP相关软骨毒性的潜在治疗靶点。
